# Auto Health Sync

> An open-source Android personal health data pipeline from Health Connect to the user's Google Drive.

Auto Health Sync reads user-approved Health Connect categories, creates compact daily JSON summaries on the device, and uploads them directly to Google Drive. It has no developer-operated backend, analytics, advertising, or independent user-account system.

- [Homepage](https://ali-sdg.is-a.dev/auto-health-sync/): Product overview, data flow, features, and downloads.
